LanguageData.BOR_DataDrive.label: data drive
LanguageData.BOR_DataDrive.description: An advanced data storage device from the Kwazaari Corporation, containing vast quantities of technical specifications and research data. Analyzing this drive will unlock advanced research capabilities for kwazaari-tier technologies.
LanguageData.BOR_CircuitBoard.label: circuit board
LanguageData.BOR_CircuitBoard.description: A complex circuit board from Kwazaari technology. Required as a component in constructing advanced kwazaari-tier research facilities.
LanguageData.BOR_DiluteTenebriteShard.label: diluted tenebrite shard
LanguageData.BOR_DiluteTenebriteShard.description: A crystalline fragment of tenebrite diluted with exotic matter from the darkest reaches of space. This shard contains the secrets of tenebral technology. Analyzing it will unlock the most advanced research pathways known to mankind.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebriteMotor.label: tenebrite motor
LanguageData.BOR_TenebriteMotor.description: A sophisticated electromagnetic motor constructed from tenebrite, capable of harnessing dark matter itself for propulsion. Analyzing this device will reveal the fundamental principles of tenebral technology.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebriteAmplifier.label: tenebrite amplifier
LanguageData.BOR_TenebriteAmplifier.description: A resonance amplifier crafted from pure tenebrite crystal. These amplifiers focus and channel dark matter fields with extraordinary precision. Required as a critical component in constructing the most advanced astronomical research equipment.
LanguageData.BOR_Attoclusters.label: attoclusters
LanguageData.BOR_Attoclusters.description: An opaque apparatus filled with attoscopic machines, clustered and waiting for an order. Container is made from picomachines and has neither a reader or an applicator. Picocluster constantly spreads and shrinks around the container, unnoticeable to naked eye; approaching user has their intentions read before they even lay eyes on the apparatus. Attomachines are kept enclosed only because they have nowhere else to be and exit through the pores of the surrounding cluster when intent is understood.
